pattern: を通じて / を通して（をつうじて / をとおして）
aliases: をつうじて / をとおして
purpose: Describe an intermediary, shared experience, or a continuous time span.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
Noun + を通じて / を通して
I got to know him through a friend.
My way of thinking changed through travel.
This town is warm throughout the year.
formation: Noun + を通じて / を通して
restrictions: Both forms mark a channel; を通して often emphasizes an active process.
mistake: For the entire span of a year, 一年を通じて means throughout, not just once.
